decision.rationale: PRR-021 prevents replay after genuinely uncertain outcomes, but PRR-022 regresses the supported single fallback for Apple's definite kAXErrorActionUnsupported result. PRR-023 also leaves canonical F6 and platform merge records on obsolete SHAs, findings, tests, and decisions.

summary: Unknown dispatched outcomes now fail closed and all configured tests and exact-head CI pass. However, native error -25206 is a definite unsupported result, not an unknown mutation, and current code suppresses the compatibility fallback explicitly built for WeChat AXRows that reject AXPress. Canonical merge-readiness and PR descriptions are also stale, so changes are required before merge.

findings.title: Definite unsupported AX actions are treated as unknown mutations
findings.observation: All non-zero native AX results become accessibility_action_failed with actionAttempted=true. WeChat checks positive attempt evidence before unsupported evidence, so the repository's -25206 fixture cannot use a fallback.
findings.trigger: A verified WeChat AXRow is offered as an AXPress target and AXUIElementPerformAction returns kAXErrorActionUnsupported (-25206).
findings.impact: Contact navigation, opening, and search flows can fail instead of using the one current-frame identity-gated fallback built for rows that omit or reject AXPress, regressing commit 303b9b4 and the changelog contract.

evidence.description: The installed macOS 26.5 SDK defines kAXErrorActionUnsupported as -25206 and says the unsuccessful call means the element does not support the action; it separately documents kAXErrorCannotComplete as potentially outcome-unknown.
client.py:4373-4385 maps every non-zero result to generic attempted failure, while tool.py:4133-4162 returns false on positive attempt evidence before unsupported classification.
test_tool.py:928-958 uses -25206 as the generic native failure and test_tool.py:1876-1904 now asserts navigation stops without a click.
A reviewer assertion that the repository's -25206 result retains one safe fallback failed with exit code 1 because the predicate returned false.
Commit 303b9b4 and CHANGELOG.md:85-87 explicitly retain fallback for WeChat AXRows that omit or reject AXPress.

findings.remediation: Preserve fail-closed handling for -25204, transport loss, malformed responses, and other uncertain outcomes, but propagate machine-readable definite-unsupported or no-effect evidence for -25206 and allow exactly one configured fallback. Evaluate AXSetFocus kAXErrorAttributeUnsupported (-25205) under the same contract.
findings.verification: Cross-package tests must prove -25206 and any adopted definite unsupported focus result execute exactly one fallback, while -25204, EOF, timeout, malformed, contradictory, and missing evidence execute zero downstream mutations; then rerun all package, root, preflight, and exact-head CI gates.

findings.title: F6 merge records publish obsolete review state
findings.observation: Merge readiness and the tracked PR description still bind ba733dc, PRR-001 through PRR-020, and old CI. The GitHub body is older and still reports REQUEST_CHANGES at 07fa052 with 12 blockers, while current head is d2dadd0 and current CI passes.
findings.trigger: A maintainer uses the canonical F6 artifacts or GitHub body to change draft state, approve, or merge the PR.
findings.impact: The repository and platform present incompatible merge decisions, finding ledgers, and verification evidence, breaking the auditable lifecycle contract.

evidence.description: Both tracked F6 descriptions were last updated in 3392c27, before the four PRR-021 finding, fix, evidence, and report commits.
feature-lifecycle F6 requires current merge-readiness and PR description updates to be committed and pushed before requesting merge.
GitHub shows exact head d2dadd0, open draft clean state, and successful run 29359074400, while the body still publishes the obsolete 07fa052 decision.

findings.remediation: After PRR-022 is fixed, synchronize merge-readiness.md, tracked pr-description.md, and the GitHub PR body with the current finding ledger, behavior contract, tests, decision, and CI; commit and push the F6 update and observe new exact-head CI.
findings.verification: The three canonical surfaces agree on the implementation snapshot, open and resolved findings, decision, public behavior, and current CI, and a replacement review report is bound to the resulting snapshot.

findings.title: Unsupported-action recovery documentation is internally contradictory
findings.observation: The docs first permit explicit unsupported action results without positive attempt evidence, then say requestDispatched=true or retryable=false always stops recovery. The synthetic unsupported worker has both values while the predicate permits fallback.
findings.trigger: A developer interprets the recovery contract or a maintainer adds another backend result shape.
findings.impact: Readers can implement the opposite precedence rule or incorrectly diagnose valid recovery, although prose alone does not alter runtime behavior.

evidence.description: docs/api.md:251-258 and docs/wechat-desktop-tool.md:460-468 contain the conflicting adjacent rules.
The exact-head synthetic unsupported result carries requestDispatched=true and retryable=false but intentionally allows one fallback.

findings.remediation: State explicitly whether definite unsupported or no-effect evidence overrides dispatch and retryability, and use the same precedence in both stable documents after PRR-022 is resolved.
findings.verification: Documentation assertions and cross-package examples agree with the final predicate for unsupported, uncertain, pre-dispatch, and contradictory outcomes.

findings.title: Downstream actions could replay after dispatched or unknown outcomes
findings.observation: The prior code could choose another mutation from a generic failure kind after an action may already have been dispatched. Current callers use one fail-closed predicate and treat an issued fallback as final.
findings.trigger: A warm action request receives EOF, times out after dispatch, returns malformed data, has missing or contradictory dispatch evidence, or reports an uncertain native error.
findings.impact: Before remediation one semantic operation could mutate the desktop twice; current unsafe-outcome tests execute zero downstream mutations.

evidence.description: All mapped navigation, contact, search, selector, Return, coordinate, and strategy paths now use the shared dispatch and attempt-aware predicate.
Eleven path and cross-package regressions pass, and ten repeated unsafe-outcome runs cover 40 EOF, timeout, malformed, and native-failure subcases with zero replay.
Exact-head GitHub CI run 29359074400 passed all configured gates.

findings.remediation: Completed for genuinely dispatched, attempted, non-retryable, contradictory, or unknown outcomes; preserve this boundary while resolving PRR-022.
findings.verification: Completed through cross-package outcomes, path-specific tests, all package and root suites, stress, preflight, and exact-head CI.

required_actions.action: Distinguish definite unsupported or no-effect native errors from uncertain attempted outcomes and add cross-package exact-one-fallback versus zero-replay regressions.
Synchronize and push merge-readiness, tracked PR description, and GitHub PR body after the code fix, then obtain exact-head green CI and re-review.

The macOS SDK contract and the repository's own -25206 fixture reproduce the compatibility defect without live WeChat.

open_questions: Should AXSetFocus map kAXErrorAttributeUnsupported (-25205) into the same definite no-effect class or use a distinct normalized failure kind?
assumptions: Apple's documented kAXErrorActionUnsupported result means the action was not supported and the call was unsuccessful, so the already policy-gated single fallback is safe.
kAXErrorCannotComplete, transport loss, and missing or contradictory evidence remain outcome-unknown and must never trigger another mutation.
The existing AXRow fallback and changelog entry are part of the intended compatibility contract.
Feature-lifecycle F6 records must agree and be pushed before merge.
